exposure: timing of seizures relative to labor onset
cohort: Eclampsia patients admitted to Jorhat Medical College and Hospital, Assam, India between January 2015 and December 2015.
finding: The incidence of eclampsia was 7.1 per 1000 deliveries, and it was more common in women aged 20-24 years, primigravidae, those with irregular antenatal check-ups, and those with seizures before labor onset.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the most common mode of delivery (60.38%).
